scope: LNG-only unit rows of the fresh gem_export.csv (Fuel in LNG/eLNG/blank)
note: Two distinct problems. (1) BLANK CapacityUnits on 5 rows -- and every one of the 5 carries a magnitude that is implausible for that facility read as mtpa, so these are not merely missing labels, the number itself is in some other unit. (2) 13% of LNG rows with a numeric Capacity are in a unit OTHER than mtpa, so any rollup that sums the Capacity column without converting is wrong. Six of those are in units with no clean mtpa conversion at all (gal/day, MWh/d, TJ/d, tpa). | 2026-08-26 follow-up: Sendai RESOLVED -- 90 is 90 t/h vaporizer capacity (ORV 30x2 + SMV 30x1), i.e. send-out/grid-injection rate, ~0.79 mtpa. "Injection capacity" is not a GEM field (no such column/key/lookup exists DB-wide); it is industry terminology for send-out into the grid.

blank_units_implausible_magnitude.finding: blank CapacityUnits AND implausible magnitude read as mtpa
blank_units_implausible_magnitude.why: Crib Point FSRU was sized around 100 PJ/year of regasification (AGL's own filings); 100 mtpa would be larger than Qatar. The number looks like an energy-per-year figure whose unit label was lost.
blank_units_implausible_magnitude.route: Update batch -- re-read the cited source, record the value in its stated unit, set CapacityUnits

blank_units_implausible_magnitude.finding: blank CapacityUnits AND implausible magnitude read as mtpa
blank_units_implausible_magnitude.why: The cited source (gas.city.sendai.jp equipment page) does not contain 90 at all. It lists the Minato plant vaporizer bank as LNG気化器 ORV 30 t/h x2 + SMV 30 t/h x1 = 90 t/h -- so the 90 is total VAPORIZATION (send-out / grid-injection) capacity in tonnes per hour and the unit was dropped. 90 t/h ~= 788,400 t/yr ~= 0.79 mtpa at full utilization, consistent with a municipal city-gas utility. The same page's storage figures are LNG tank 80,000 kL x1, gas holders 100,000 m3, LPG 148 kL x2, berth 18,800 kL-class. RESOLVED 2026-08-26: recommend Capacity 0.79 mtpa (or 90 t/h if the schema gains t/h), not 90 mtpa. Supersedes the earlier guess that 90 was a tank volume in kL -- it is not.
blank_units_implausible_magnitude.route: Update batch -- re-read the cited source, record the value in its stated unit, set CapacityUnits
blank_units_implausible_magnitude.derivation: 30 t/h ORV x2 + 30 t/h SMV x1 = 90 t/h; x 8760 h = 788,400 t/yr = 0.79 mtpa

blank_units_implausible_magnitude.finding: blank CapacityUnits AND implausible magnitude read as mtpa
